shared_tail.surface: إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين

notes: «قال أبو علي حدثنا» names no shaykh for Abu Ali: his route ends at him, and the single tail after «عثمان أنبأنا داود بن قيس» is attached to both routes
«تابعه الضحاك بن عثمان» names another narrator for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
the Prophet's «حبي» in the saying is not a link; Ali is the last link
